title: Have a critical infrastructure risk management program
what: The responsible entity for a critical infrastructure asset covered by Part 2A must adopt and maintain a risk management program.

sources.title: Security of Critical Infrastructure Act 2018
sources.quote: 30AC Responsible entity must have a critical infrastructure risk management program If an entity is the responsible entity for one or more critical infrastructure assets, the entity must: (a) adopt; and (b) maintain; a critical infrastructure risk management program

reach.condition: if it is the responsible entity for a critical infrastructure asset to which Part 2A applies
